strings.en: So we're finally going in...
Can we stop it? What if we get inside and it's still no good...
Lieutenant Emma, you won't know till you try, will ya?
Shinobu's being his usual self, but I don't think it's impossible either.
On what grounds?
Strictly speaking, that isn't an asteroid... Masato, you've seen it too.
Originally it was no bigger than a meteorite...
...Indeed. Parts of the asteroid belt, wreckage from destroyed colonies...
all of it gathered together and grew into that thing.
So if we destroy its center... the original meteorite... is that the idea?
Exactly. Mind you, it's only a possibility.
Even if we destroy it, something that's grown that huge
might not stop just because of that.
...However, that is the only option with any chance...
In that case, we should cast aside our doubts.
If it comes to that, I'll dig a hole all the way to the core!
I'll be counting on it.
...But how long would it take to dig a hole big enough for Dancougar?
Captain, any contact with the Gandor Team?
...We can't get through. Not only that, Von Braun, Anaheim...
communication with every location has become impossible.
Is that the plant planet's doing?
No doubt about it. It seems we're completely cut off.
Going in is fine, but if we can't contact anyone else,
we can't tell anyone we're on that planet... Will we be all right?
If the Gandor Team survived, then most likely someone...
Yes, someone will notice.
All we need to think about is stopping that asteroid.
That's not like you, Quattro. Is it really okay to be that optimistic?
I don't believe it's optimism... It seems there's someone
you place your trust in.
Trust? ...Well, perhaps.
(Provided they can break free of Earth's gravity, that is...)
Hmmm...
Kappei, what's wrong? We're going in any minute!
Something up?
The Gaizok have been real quiet lately.
I was wondering when they'd show up.
Heh, we beat 'em up pretty good. Maybe they learned their lesson?
What are you all huddled up discussing?
We're going in soon, you know?
Oh, hello... We were just saying how quiet the Gaizok have been.
They're probably waiting to see how things play out.
Waiting to see?
Their goal is... to wipe out the people of Earth, right?
So if the plant planet were to hit Earth...
Then they'd get what they want.
...I doubt that's all there is to it.
Oh, it's the sunglasses robot guy.
Hey now, knock it off with the "sunglasses robot."
A new nickname! I'll have to tell Drill about this.
Jet, what do you mean, you doubt that's all?
Hm, oh... I may be overthinking it, but...
maybe they want to finish off their chosen prey with their own hands?
What's that supposed to mean?
Hmm... So even if the goal's the same, having someone else steal their kill
isn't something they'd just sit back and accept... is that it?
That's about it. And if they still aren't attacking at a time like this...
maybe there's some other reason.
Aren't you reading too much into it?
Whatever. If they came now, we wouldn't have time to deal with 'em.
That's what it comes down to.
Not here either... Where's Rom?
Hm? Oh, Kina.
He's not here.
He was over on the bridge, sis.
You sure, Kina? We're about to cross a seriously risky bridge.
I don't mind. If Rom's going... I'm going with him.
Heh... Rom sure is popular.
I-It's not like that!
...Hey, Keiko.
What is it, Uchuta?
The Captain's chatting with them like it's normal... Quite a sight, huh?
I know... I mean, Jet and the others are robots.
It doesn't really matter. They might look like robots...
they're just people from a planet like that.
Now that you mention it... maybe the only difference is how they look.
So we're finally going in... Heh,
I'm not Tenkawa earlier or anything, but I'm a little nervous.
Yeah... We're going inside some weird planet, after all.
I smell something nasty.
Yeah, if anything, I'd call it the smell of danger.
No. ...Inside the planet... it'll smell like a plant-et! Ugh, it reeks!
What're you yapping about over there!?
We're swapping frames for the assault, so make sure you check
your own Aestivalis!
Huh? Uri-P, where's Yamada?
He's been tuning his Aestivalis this whole time... Look, he's done.
Heh, all fired up, huh?
Of course! A warrior of justice heading for the enemy stronghold...!
If that doesn't fire you up, you're no man!
Get fired up all you want... but you and Ryoko
need to treat your machines a little better!
We came back alive, didn't we? Don't be so uptight!
Yeah, yeah, we've made it this far without a big loss.
That's what counts, right, Tenkawa!? ...Hey, where'd Tenkawa go?
Akito? He went to the bridge.
We could get sortie orders any minute. What's he doing?
He probably went to go look at Captain Yurika's face,
that Tenkawa... Wh-What!?
Tenkawa, Tenkawa...
Tenkawa, Tenkawa...
I see, Ryoko. ...Tenkawa, huh? Tenkawa! Dammit!
Why's it always him!?
Wh-What, you too, Uribatake? What're you saying!?
I was talking about maintenance on Tenkawa's unit...
Hey, listen to me!
...Why's Subaru all red in the face...?
...Shaff... Everyone... The people of Londo Bell and the Gandor Team...
are they safe...?
Please calm yourself, Princess. I'm sure the Gandor Team is fine...
Joe and the others are there, and Tobikage will surely lend its power.
I can't speak for Joe, but Tobikage, certainly.
That's right! And out in space, Big Bro Banjo is with Londo Bell,
so he'll beat 'em in no time.
I know... But...
Such a worrier, Princess. What will be, will be.
It may sound cold, but we're stuck here at Anaheim,
so there's no use flailing around about it.
Besides, it'd be bad if we rushed out and got caught by the Meganoids.
Toppo! I already said I was sorry about that!
I agree that what will be, will be.
Well, sure, but...
See? Now the Princess has gone and gotten all gloomy!
Princess Romina, it'll be fine.
All we can do is... believe in them.
Nina...
The Gandor Team on Earth... succeeded in retaking Jaburo.
What...!? Then the fighting on Earth is...
It seems to be settled, for now. No casualties...
And the Gandor Team will be heading up to space, Princess.
Thank goodness... Joe.
What about Londo Bell!? Still no word from them?
No... Not a word since that giant asteroid appeared...
Even if we win on Earth, it's all for nothing if that thing hits...
Nor any lead on the ninja. Damn, all we can do is sit and watch...!
I wonder if Banjo's behaving himself.
If that asteroid hits Earth, I won't let him off easy.
...That's a lot different from how Joe gets treated...
(Kou... Are you... fighting there too...?)
What's up, Judau? You're all lost in thought.
Shouldn't you leave the thinking to the Captain
and Captain Quattro? It's not your thing, Judau.
Yeah, yeah.
Seriously.
Shut up! You're all saying whatever you want!
Popular guy, Judau.
Oh, Banjo. Don't tease me.
Being surrounded by this bunch doesn't make me happy or anything...
"This bunch"!?
I bet you'd rather have someone like Beauty or Reika! Honestly!
...Well, it's not as great as it sounds...
I was thinking about Haman!
...She hasn't shown herself even once yet, you know!?
...Well, that's...
She's gotta be sitting back somewhere, watching us fight.
Even if we stop the asteroid, the fighting's far from over.
Judau...
...I kinda get it.
Exactly. I wanted to go to Mars too...
but there wasn't time for that then, and there isn't now.
...Still, what we have to do is clear.
Oh, there you are... Everyone, the Captain wants you on the bridge.
Please hurry.
So it's time... Got it, I'll be right there.
Haman... When this fight's over, I'm settling things with you...!
Yurika! Hey, are you seriously...
Akito! I know, before charging into an enemy planet,
wanting one look at the person you love is only natural, but...
Akito, is that true...!?
My, my, Akito, you can be bold when it counts.
As if!! Like I said, are you seriously going into that planet...
But no, Akito. We're in the middle of an operation, and on the bridge...
Listen to me!!
Learn the Captain's personality by now... or rather, her habits.
Now, now... Tenkawa, are you against going into the planet?
Y-Yeah... We don't need to join an operation this dangerous, do we?
But at this rate, that planet will hit Earth...
I'm saying the Nadesico doesn't need to go along too!
The Ra Cailum's team should be enough on its own.
What's wrong? Why bring this up all of a sudden...?
No reason... Just, in case something happens, we don't all need to go in...
Ahh, I see. Tenkawa, you're worried about Jupiter...
so you'd rather avoid a risky operation here.
Indeed, ever since the incident at Von Braun, the Jovian forces
have been left completely unattended...
Well, can't that wait for now?
...The Nadesico will join the Ra Cailum in entering the plant planet.
Why!? There's no need for all of us to do something this dangerous...
We're all going because it's dangerous.
That raises our chances of success, right?
Like they say, cross the street together, and red light or green,
there's nothing to be scared of!
You're misusing that saying.
I get the "together" part, but...
Well... we haven't caught the Jovian forces' movements either way...
so it'd be quicker to finish the business in front of us first.
Hmm... Quite so.
Given our current situation, the Captain's call may be the best one.
Even you, Prospector...
If the Ra Cailum team were to fail the operation,
continuing it with the Nadesico alone would be difficult.
I see... The Nadesico alone probably can't match all the forces
aboard the Ra Cailum...
See? Going together is best!
Ugh... But...
Tenkawa, don't be a sore loser.
Besides... you're not the only one worried about the Jovian forces...
Minato...
Akito... So let's do our best and get rid of that planet, quick!
Y-Yeah... You're right... Everyone's fighting
for the things they want to do, too...
That's right. So I'll hear all about your burning feelings, Akito,
somewhere just the two of us once the operation's over. Don't worry!
Captain!
H-Hey, don't cling to me like that, Yurika!
(...Working hard for the future you want,
is something everyone does as a matter of course...)
Nothing but idiots...
Hm...? Excellen... are you all right?
...Sure.
...That last one that showed up... What on earth was that...
The supervisor... that was...
Yes... originally... this Earth was...
...Hey, Excellen!? What are you... Snap out of it!
What's wrong? The pilots have been called to the bridge, you know.
Huh? Excellen... you look really pale...
No... I don't know. All of a sudden...
...Hm...? Oh my? Wh-What's up? Everyone's gathered around...
Don't "what's up" us! You were acting weird!
Yeah... though she seems fine now...
Aren't you just tired? You weren't acting like yourself.
She seems all right now, though...
It was kinda creepy, I tell ya.
Hey, hey now, calling a fine woman like me
creepy? That's not very nice, is it, Boss?
Back to your usual self. Bright's calling for us. Let's go.
Wow, we're finally going in!
Sheesh, I worried for nothing. ...So what's the Captain want?
The plan for going in, maybe?
What plan? All we can do is charge in!
Looks like there's nothing wrong with you.
Right. Someone out sick this far in wouldn't be funny.
So, what's Bright want?
The plan for going in, probably.
Hmph, we just charge the core together. Who needs a briefing...
Maybe the briefing's about watching out for members like that?
Could be.
That's not funny.
(...Kyosuke... I... something's... wrong with me...
Is it... because of that girl...? And you...?)
Is everyone... here?
This is it, huh, Bright?
We don't... have much time, do we?
So it's... time.
Do we have time, Captain?
...Hardly any.
And even if we board that plant planet,
there's no guarantee we can keep it from hitting Earth...
Nothing but "no"s, huh.
Guarantee or not, there's only one thing to do, ain't there?
The Cyber Beast Force always says the same thing.
...But this time, I agree.
We're short on time, too.
It seems we've been... misunderstood. Shinobu's fault, I suppose.
Not just his, though, right?
No point dithering. So, what do we do?
...It turned out like this after all, huh, Umon?
Much better than planning in despair... Besides...
Besides?
The people here, and their machines, have the power to turn this around...
Exactly. And this isn't the end. There are still more foes
we have to defeat. ...We have to go to Mars, too.
Iron Mask... and Zeon's movements worry me too.
Let's hurry up and deal with this planet already.
A head-on fight, then. Are all Earthlings like this?
Oh? Then do you have a better plan, Jet?
You don't actually mind, do you, Jet?
...I don't dislike it.
Never could just say it, huh?
Everyone agrees. ...Looks like going is our only option.
Even if we didn't agree, it would have to be done.
...Good grief. I'd rather you didn't work an old man so hard.
A fighting heart... knows no age.
So long as you don't abandon that will yourself.
Right, Captain. We haven't even fought yet. All we can do is try!
...Morale hasn't dropped, it seems... I'm relieved.
Right. The Ra Cailum, of independent Federation unit Londo Bell,
will now enter the unidentified asteroid...!
Roger... This looks like it'll be a turning point.
...Whichever way it turns.
Hm? Excellen...?
...Kyosuke...
What is the meaning of this... Abel!
Attacking them, and then welcoming them onto our land...!
...Lady Diore, I beg you, understand Abel's will.
I, Abel, will crush those people and their so-called Earthling pride,
and fulfill our long-cherished wish... This I promise you...!
Heh... Hahahahaha.
What's so funny...!
Pride or defeat... which will remain, I wonder?
Shapiro...!
Lord Shapiro! So this is where you were!
...They're coming... Heh heh... Sara...
Lord Shapiro...
Danger...
...Danger.
Destroy...
...this...
The time... is now...
Summon... that one...
